corrections.issue: Baltas says moderate equity exposure on the upside may preserve capital in a downturn and so may not maximise the average (arithmetic) return, but he adds 'I think that geometric it would', i.e. it may improve the compounded return; the first reader drops the geometric point.
corrections.fix: Capping equity exposure on the upside decorrelates from the beta portfolio; Baltas has a gut feeling that it preserves capital in downturns and may not maximise the average return but could maximise the geometric (compounded) return.

corrections.issue: Dunne raises the 1929-32 fall (about 89%) as showing a 2x leveraged equity ETF could be wiped out, but the conclusion that matching equity vol (about 15%) is as aggressive as one would go is Baltas's own view, explicitly labelled as reflecting his level of risk aversion and subjective, not Dunne's.
corrections.fix: Dunne notes equities fell about 89% in 1929-32 so a 2x leveraged equity ETF would be wiped out; Baltas replies that for an overall portfolio, matching equity volatility (about 15%) is probably as aggressive as he would go, a subjective view reflecting his risk aversion.

corrections.issue: The 'Sharpe close to one' belongs to the time-series carry portfolios after optimisation, which Baltas describes as having stable performance through time (stated before the beta-constraint discussion), not to the combined carry and trend portfolio; the combination is described only as complementary.
corrections.fix: Optimised time-series carry portfolios reduce correlation to the beta markets and show a stable Sharpe ratio close to one, but their rolling correlations to equities and bonds vary over time; constraining beta to equities and Treasuries to zero controls this, and the paper concludes carry is a complementary strategy to trend (for example a 50/50 trend and carry mix on top of the S&P 500).

completeness_estimate: 0.78 - first reader caught the main arguments of both papers (Quantica crisis beta/alpha numbers, Resolve carry definitions, correlations, universe and complementarity) accurately; missed methodological detail and supporting points: quarter-bucketing method, regression caveat, short-only motivation, upside cost, what to do with freed risk when capping, beta neutralisation mechanics (AHL linear beta, equity beta in other markets), June 2024 attribution and vol-scaling, drawdown rule of thumb, horizon dependence of timing, and several carry design details
